description:
A single Agent OS event (proposal §10.2).

Required header: ``event_id`` (``evt_`` ULID), ``event_type``,
``occurred_at`` (UTC), and ``machine_id`` (every event originates on a
machine).  The remaining context fields are nullable because not every event
is scoped to an agent, session, project, repository, or task.

event_type.description: Open dot-namespaced event type (e.g. 'task.completed'). Producers SHOULD use a value from the EventType registry; consumers accept any well-formed domain.verb string so unknown types stay routable.
event_type.title: Event Type

occurred_at.description: When the event occurred (timezone-aware UTC ISO-8601).
occurred_at.title: Occurred At

payload.description: Event-type-specific body; opaque to the envelope.
payload.title: Payload

title: EventEnvelope
